wall_name: Living room shelf beside framed GOSH! print
notes: Wide living-room shot; white modern bookshelf partly visible at right edge of frame next to a framed 'GOSH!' print. Camera settles here after t_005056 (motion-blurred). Most spines too small/angled to read at video resolution; only the yellow 'Everyman's Talmud' spine (orange lettering) is clearly legible, plus one spine with Hebrew-script lettering (title itself illegible) and a black spine with a bold 'K' (too little text to identify safely, folded into unlabelled).

wall_name: Study shelving with subject tab labels 'FRANCOFORTE' and 'DELEUZE'

rows.row_label: right column, shelf with book/medallion display

notes: Study shelving organized by subject, with printed tab dividers reading 'FRANCOFORTE' (Frankfurt School) and 'DELEUZE' visible on shelf edges (metadata, not a book title). A man (interviewee) reaches up to the shelf, partly obscuring several spines. Right-hand bay mixes books with small framed medallions/plaques. Most spine text too small/blurred at this camera distance to read reliably; two Editori Laterza-style grey/black paperback spines with a small circular publisher emblem were visible but title text unrecoverable, folded into unlabelled counts.

wall_name: Antiquarian leather-bound shelf behind Eco's interview seat
notes: Eco is seated for interview directly in front of this shelf, giving a sharp, well-lit view. Top shelf holds worn red/brown leather-bound volumes with gilt spine bands and one dark green/black leather spine clearly reading 'LE ROY SOLEIL' (French, on Louis XIV) in gilt capitals. Lower shelf holds a uniform-bound set in green/black leather with repeated gilt diamond tooling (likely an encyclopedia or collected-works set); no individual volume titles legible. Camera later cuts to an extreme close-up of Eco's face (t_005704 tail) which obscures much of the shelf.
